newsitem.title: UK: Scotia shares fall after annual results.
newsitem.headline: Scotia shares fall after annual results.

text.p: Shares in Scotia Holdings Plc fell on Tuesday after the British biotech company announced an increase in operating losses in 1996 and a corporate restructuring.
The shares fell 10p to 369 by 0836 GMT.
One analyst said an absence of news in the results statement was one of the main reasons for the slide in the share price.

"There won't really be a news flow until later this year or early next year when the Foscan results come in, or perhaps the rhuematoid arthritis product some time in the second half of this year, but that's going to be licensed out anyway," the dealer said. "So we're really looking at six months of having nothing to say about Scotia."
Analysts said one surprise in the results had been an increase in sales of nutritional pharmaceutical products in the second half. "But this may have been stock building," one said.
